verdict: MRVL Investor Day (today) is the focal point; optical stocks surged on Bernstein sector sweep (COHR +10%, LITE +9%, CIEN +7%); HBM prices set to double in 2027, not correct; MU record earnings but sell-the-news fade; Section 232 solar tariffs signed.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (Oct 3–6, 2026)

**Optical sector surge (Oct 1–2):** Bernstein initiated COHR, LITE, CIEN at Outperform — "structural winners in AI infrastructure." Coherent launched PhotonLink AI datacenter platform (10+ customer architecture engagements); COHR **+10%**, LITE **+9%**, CIEN **+7%** on Oct 1, further gains Oct 2. CRDO acquired DustPhotonics (silicon photonics, 800G–3.2T roadmap). InP Q4 2026 price hike #4 expected. Ciena at Futurecom today (Oct 6).

**MRVL Investor Day — TODAY (Oct 6):** Marvell hosting Investor Day in NYC targeting ~$18B FY2028 revenue, $10B+ custom-chip business in FY2029. RBC expects FY2029 AI revenue forecast raised $2B+. Stock up 221% YTD.

**MU record earnings, sell-the-news fade:** FY2026 full-year $133.19B revenue (+256% YoY); Q4 $54.23B; strong Q1 guide. Stock ~-1% post-report. Susquehanna says stock could nearly double.

**HBM: No correction signal.** Seoul Economic Daily (Oct 1): HBM prices expected to **more than double in 2027** as shortage persists. SK Hynix 16-layer HBM4 in volume at ~$550/stack; Micron in volume on 12-layer HBM4.

**HDD whipsaw:** Toshiba announced plans to double HDD output → STX **-10%**, WDC **-7%** (Oct 2). Both recovered Oct 5 (+5%/+6.5%) on Bernstein/Citi/Morgan Stanley pushback.

**Solar — Section 232 signed:** Trump signed 15% polysilicon tariffs + minimum import prices (modules $0.38/W, cells $0.22/W), effective Dec 4. ENPH +2%, ARRY +1% on foreign inverter restrictions. FSLR Piper Sandler PT cut $260→$251, Overweight maintained; FSLR sued JA Solar for patent infringement.

**NVDA** hit all-time high Oct 5. $108B Q3 FY2027 guide from August unchanged; no guide-down.

**SNOW** pre-market ~-3% Oct 6 on ASOS data breach involving Snowflake platform.

**HIVE:** $570M GPU cloud contracts; GPU cloud ARR targeting ~$180M.

## Context vs. Baseline

- **HBM pricing is moving opposite to the correction signal.** Baseline flagged SK Hynix warning of post-2026 correction; Oct 1 news says prices to double again in 2027. Monitor Q4 supply additions closely.
- **NVIDIA $350B consensus track** — all-time high, no guide-down; $108B Q3 guide above prior $103.9B consensus.
- **Optical accelerating faster than baseline expected** (CPO penetration "low through 2027") — Bernstein sweep signals faster-than-forecast CPO/scale-out deployment.
- **AMD Helios real but NVDA share intact** at ~80–92% AI accelerator market.

## Most Important Development

**MRVL Investor Day today (Oct 6):** Marvell laying out a custom-ASIC roadmap targeting $18B FY2028 revenue and $10B+ AI custom silicon by FY2029 — the clearest scheduled catalyst in the AI compute share-shift story. Any NVIDIA partnership naming or new hyperscaler design-win would be a major signal.
